hero.heading: Everything your best friend needs, from one shop that actually knows them
hero.text: Food, toys, beds and check-ups for dogs, cats and the small ones too. Same-day pickup at 12 stores, or delivered before dinner.

sections.heading: Built for dogs
sections.text: Breed-matched food plans, chew-tested toys and beds sized from dachshund to Great Dane.

sections.heading: Built for cats
sections.text: Litter that stays put, trees that survive claws, and a grooming room with the door shut.

sections.heading: Vets on site
sections.text: Walk-in vaccinations, dental cleaning and nail trims. Book online, wait time shown live.

sections.heading: Supported by people who own pets
sections.text: Every Pawprint store is run by a team that goes home to at least one animal. Ask them anything.

sections.heading: Chosen by shelters and breeders across the country
Rescue Sundays
sections.text: Every Sunday a local shelter brings adoptable animals to the store. Bring treats, leave with a friend.

cards.heading: Dog food
cards.text: Dry, wet and fresh-frozen, sorted by age and size. Subscribe and never run out.

cards.heading: Cat trees
cards.text: Sisal posts, hideouts and window perches. Ships flat, assembles without tools.

cards.heading: Grooming
cards.text: Bath, trim and de-shed in under an hour. Nervous pets get the quiet room.

cards.heading: Aquarium starter kit
cards.text: Tank, filter, heater and the first month of food. Fish not included, advice is.

cards.heading: Small animals
cards.text: Rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters: hay, hutches and the vet who knows them.

cards.heading: Adoption
cards.text: Partner shelters list their animals here. Meet them at Rescue Sunday.

footer.text: © 2026 Pawprint Pet Shop. Open every day, 9 to 8.
